sentences.text: The petitioner is aggrieved by Ext.P7 order issued by the 2nd respondent, by which the restaurant run by the petitioner was ordered to be closed.
Being aggrieved by the same, the petitioner submitted a statutory appeal, before the Corporation Council as evidenced by Ext.P9 on the next day itself.
The limited relief sought by the petitioner is to direct the 1 st respondent to consider the said appeal and to pass appropriate orders thereon.
After hearing the learned Counsel for the petitioner and the learned Standing Counsel for the Corporation, I am of the view that, this writ petition can be disposed of.

In such circumstances, it is ordered that, the 1st respondent shall consider Ext.P9 and appropriate orders thereon shall be passed after hearing the petitioner and the 4th respondent on whose complaint the proceedings are initiated.
Appropriate orders in this regard shall be passed within a period of one month from the date of receipt of a 2025:KER:10291 WP(C) NO. 3111 OF 2025 copy of this judgment.

It is ordered that, the interim order already passed by this Court on 24.01.2025 shall continue in force until a decision is taken by the 1st respondent on Ext.P9.
Sd/-
ZIYAD RAHMAN A.A. JUDGE scs 2025:KER:10291 WP(C) NO. 3111 OF 2025 APPENDIX OF WP(C) 3111/2025 PETITIONER EXHIBITS
